title: I just can't get comfortable enough to sleep using this
text:
I just can't get comfortable enough to sleep using this. It feels pretty good at first. Then after a while, I realize that it is just a little too thick for me. If I could just shave about an inch off of the height of this it might work. I can lay in bed and watch TV with it but I just can't sleep using it.

Sorry. I had huge hopes when I first saw this. It is a great idea but just not perfect for me. This one is much better than the orange version this company offers. The orange one is extremely firm for me. Now, my wife prefers the harder orange one.

One of these might just be what you are looking for. I am very sorry that it didn't quite work for me.
